sections.title: A fairy tale in 17 worlds
sections.intro: The Duskweaver has knotted the Dawn Door shut and tangled every world with his arrows. Read how Prince Arlo and Pip the owl climb the tower, one painted page at a time. The prologue is open to everyone; each world's chapter opens as you reach it in the arrow puzzle game, in your browser or on Android, and its last pages once you free its guardian.

sections.title: Seventeen guardians under a curse
sections.intro: At the top of every world, on its last level, a guardian waits above the board, cursed by the Duskweaver. Arrows that fly out of the top hit it; the last hit breaks the curse and frees it. Each one fights in its own way. Tap a card to turn it over.

image.alt: Bramble, the Meadow guardian: a cursed hedgehog wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Bramble
items.text: The hedgehog of the Meadow. The first guardian, curled in violet thorns. No shield at all: learn how hits, the health bar and the curse clock work.
items.back: Every arrow that flies out of the top of the board hits him. Land enough hits before the curse clock runs out and the thorns fall away. His clock is the most patient of all, so take your time.

image.alt: Mossback, the Jungle guardian: a cursed gorilla wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Mossback
items.text: The gorilla of the Jungle. He holds up a shield of solid stone that covers half of the top edge.
items.back: The shield covers one half of the top. After every 4 hits it swings to the other half. An arrow that flies into it bumps and costs a heart, so strike where it isn't.

image.alt: Cinder, the Volcano guardian: a cursed lava dragon wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Cinder
items.text: The lava dragon of the Volcano. She guards the crater with a wall of fire that burns in a single colour.
items.back: Her half shield is fire of one colour: arrows of that colour fly straight through it and hit her, any other colour bumps. It changes sides every 4 hits.

image.alt: Rollo, the Desert guardian: a cursed sun scarab wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Rollo
items.text: The sun scarab of the Desert. He rolls a cursed sun across the sand, from side to side.
items.back: The sun covers a third of the top and rolls on every 4 hits: left, middle, right, and back. Count the hits and aim at the open thirds.

image.alt: Old Shellby, the Lagoon guardian: a cursed sea turtle wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Old Shellby
items.text: The sea turtle of the Lagoon. He drifts under the frozen lagoon, and his spells freeze the path.
items.back: No shield, but twice in the fight, as his health drops, he casts frost: ice blocks fall in your arrows' way. Ice melts as you clear other arrows, so keep moving.

image.alt: Puffcap, the Mushroom forest guardian: a cursed toad wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Puffcap
items.text: The toad of the Mushroom forest. He puffs out a cursed shield, and gets quicker when he's hurt.
items.back: His half shield swaps every 4 hits, then every 3 once he is below half health. He also has rage: every tap that doesn't hit him counts down, and at zero he strikes and takes a heart. A hit calms him.

image.alt: Oakheart, the Autumn woods guardian: a cursed great stag wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Oakheart
items.text: The great stag of the Autumn woods. A shield of one colour is woven through his antlers.
items.back: Only arrows of the shield's colour get through it. Paint tiles in the Autumn woods can recolour an arrow on its way out, so plan which colour reaches the top.

image.alt: Frostbeard, the Glacier guardian: a cursed yeti wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Frostbeard
items.text: The yeti of the Glacier. Half of him hides behind a wall of ice, and his roar freezes the board.
items.back: His ice wall covers half of the top and moves every 4 hits, and twice in the fight he casts frost that drops ice blocks in your arrows' way.

image.alt: Prism, the Crystal caves guardian: a cursed crystal golem wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Prism
items.text: The crystal golem of the Crystal caves. His shield shines in two colours, one after the other.
items.back: Each time his half shield moves, it changes between two colours. Only arrows of the colour it shows pass through, so the right colour and the right side both matter.

image.alt: Petalwing, the Cherry blossom guardian: a cursed crane wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Petalwing
items.text: The crane of the Cherry blossom. Her wings cover almost the whole sky, leaving one narrow gap.
items.back: Her wings ward almost all of the top, leaving one gap that drifts on every 4 hits. Thread your arrows through it. She has rage too, so don't tap at random.

image.alt: Sir Sprocket, the Clockwork town guardian: a cursed clockwork knight wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Sir Sprocket
items.text: The clockwork knight of the Clockwork town. Only he still marches when every clock in town has stopped.
items.back: His gear shield sweeps across the top a third at a time, every 3 hits. Look for the switches: every machine in Clockwork town has a way to open it.

image.alt: Inkwell, the Coral reef guardian: a cursed octopus wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Inkwell
items.text: The octopus of the Coral reef. Eight cursed arms, and clouds of ink that swallow the paths.
items.back: Twice in the fight he squirts ink: a cloud covers some arrows, and they have to wait until it clears after a few more arrows leave. Count your shots.

image.alt: Snapjaw, the Bayou guardian: a cursed alligator wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Snapjaw
items.text: The alligator of the Bayou. His two shields close in from both sides like jaws.
items.back: The shields start at both ends of the top and close in every 4 hits, so the gap gets smaller as the fight goes on. He has rage as well: shoot fast, before they bite.

image.alt: Gumdrop, the Candy land guardian: a cursed gummy knight wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Gumdrop
items.text: The gummy knight of the Candy land. His shield changes colour every time it moves.
items.back: Watch the colour, not the knight: his half shield moves every 4 hits and takes on a new colour each time, and only arrows of that colour slip through.

image.alt: Stone Sentinel, the Temple ruins guardian: a cursed stone sentinel wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: The Stone Sentinel
items.text: The stone sentinel of the Temple ruins. Two great stone hands rise from the floor to guard its face.
items.back: The hands move like a slow puzzle, one shielding while the other opens, and change every 4 hits. Twice in the fight it casts frost as well.

image.alt: Stormwing, the Sky islands guardian: a cursed thunder griffin wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: Stormwing
items.text: The thunder griffin of the Sky islands. He circles between the islands, his shield flashing from place to place.
items.back: His half shield moves after every 2 hits, the quickest of all. He casts frost twice and ink once on the way down.

image.alt: Duskweaver, the Starlight guardian: a cursed moth sorcerer wrapped in violet thorns and arrows

items.title: The Duskweaver
items.text: The moth sorcerer of the Starlight. He sealed the Dawn Door. Every knot he tied, he tied twice.
items.back: The last fight, on level 500, uses everything: a moving gap that shifts every 3 hits, then every 2, rage from a third of the way in, frost and ink. Free him and the Dawn Door opens.

items.q: How do I unlock the chapters?
items.a: Play Exitwise. The prologue and the Meadow's opening are open from the start. Each world's chapter opens when you reach that world, and its last pages when you free its guardian on the world's last level. The finale waits at level 500.

items.q: Why are my chapters locked on this page?
items.a: This page reads your progress from Exitwise in your browser on this site, in the same browser. Play a few levels there and come back: the chapters you have reached open here too. Progress from the Android app shows in the app's own Storybook, the Story button on the map.

items.q: Can I read the story in the game?
items.a: Yes. A world's pages play over the map when you reach it and when you free its guardian, and you can skip them at any time. Tap Story on the map to read any chapter again. If you'd rather not see them, turn off "Show story pages" in Settings; the Storybook still fills up.

items.q: Who are Prince Arlo and Pip?
items.a: Arlo is a young knight archer with a golden sun bow; he believes every arrow has a way out. Pip is a little owl who carries a lantern holding the last spark of dawn. Together they climb the Tower of Worlds to open the Dawn Door.
Seven songs, from the prologue's music box to the guardians' march and the Dawn Door. Press the music button in the book to hear them as you read, or listen to the whole Exitwise soundtrack.
The finale and the epilogue open. The story ends, but the game goes on: the shadows of old guardians come back as echoes on later levels, and Prince Arlo takes up his bow again.

cta.title: Free the next world
cta.text: Every arrow puzzle you clear brings Prince Arlo closer to the Dawn Door. Free on Android and in your browser.
